directions.goal: Identify a person whose paternal grandfather was born in a British colony between 1929 and 1935, and whose father represented a state in the Parliament.
source_clues: The father of their father was born in a British colony between 1929 and 1935 (inclusive).
Their father represented a state in house of the Parliament.
